headline: Treadmill tempo done — reps hit, feel marked Poor, watch the amber trend
summary:
Prescribed-equivalent quality session: 6x4:53 at ~166bpm (zone 4) plus warm-up blocks, all 6 reps completed, cadence steady at 83spm. HR bands were on target but RPE 3 / feel 4 (Poor) is a notch worse than the recent norm for this type of session — worth noting given yesterday's HRV dipped to 43 and today's sits at 48, right on the GREEN/AMBER line. RHR 49 and sleep 6.8h are both fine, so this reads as AMBER-ish executed under acceptable conditions, not a red flag, but it's the second day running of a flat-to-poor feel after Tuesday's amber call. Remember intervals.icu's load (49) likely undercounts this treadmill interval session by ~20-25%, so treat the completed reps and on-target HR as the real signal, not the raw TSS.</summary>
